'''LNG Esports''' is a Chinese team.

== History ==
In May 2019, [[Snake Esports]] rebranded to '''LNG Esports''', LNG standing for '''Li-Ning Gaming'''. Li-Ning is a Chinese athletic apparel company.<ref>[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Li-Ning Li-Ning on Wikipedia]</ref> LNG inherited both the [[LPL/2019 Season/Summer Season|LPL 2019 Summer]] seed and roster that belonged to Snake.

== Trivia ==
* '''LNG''' stands for '''Li-Ning Gaming'''.
* The team is owned by Li Qi-Lin (李麒麟), nephew of Olympic gold medalist [[wikipedia:en:Li Ning|Li Ning]] (李宁).
* The mascot in the team's logo is a [[wikipedia:qilin|Qi-Lin]] (麒麟), a mysterious beast in Chinese mythology, which may also be a reference to the team owner's name.
